## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.14

### 🌍 Localization
- Rolls up the recent prerelease localization work into a main release.
- Adds Home Assistant UI translations for setup, options, entities, repair text, and the X-Sense Recordings panel across the documented language set.
- Adds runtime language matching for Norwegian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese variants.

### 📚 Documentation
- Adds SKP0A keypad-code automation instructions across the translated README files.
- Adds import links for the camera notification blueprint and both SKP0A keypad blueprints across the translated README set.
- Notes the localized Home Assistant UI support on the main README.

### 📷 Cameras
- Includes the recent prerelease camera live-view and recording playback work.
